title: Life Cycle Hot Air Balloon Adventures

services.name: Lifecycle Balloon Adventures
services.desc: Boulder Champagne Flights: Hour to an hour and a half flight followed by a traditional champagne toast from our northeast Boulder location. We fly 2 -5 passengers per balloon. Enjoy a personalized balloon flight for you and your group without being stuffed into a 10-15 passenger basket. We also specialize in private flights for two. We offer coffee, tea & hot chocolate for you while you watch the balloons being setup and then we follow each hot air balloon flight with a special champagne toast, to celebrate your flight in true ballooning tradition. Non-alcohol champagne is available upon request. $195 per adult, children 12 and under $145
